stages.name: Build
stages.summary: Laravel backends with explicit, readable architecture, and a Vue or React front end on top. Code the next developer can pick up without a tour.

stages.name: Ship
stages.summary: Every change is built into an image and pushed through a pipeline, so a release is a repeatable step and not an event.

stages.name: Run
stages.summary: Kubernetes workloads, reverse proxies and Linux hosts, operated with uptime and observability ahead of feature speed.
